messages:
katie.marketing: Hey @eng-runtime — we need a quick spot-check of metrics/data for the launch demo next Tue. Can you run sanity runs on the demo workload and export: p50/p95/p99 latencies, tokens/sec, cold vs warm heatmap, and a small sample of outputs? Minimal artifacts for slides: CSV, small JSON of outputs (10 per variant). Need short methodology notes. Deadline: Mon EOD. Thanks!

jon.runtime: Got it. Quick q: which model + quantization combo? Do you want hosted vs dedicated numbers? Also, exact sample corpus?

katie.marketing: Primary target is open-model-xxl fp16 and an int8-quantized variant (quantized for cost slide). Hosted numbers are fine for the headline; we also want dedicated numbers for the SLA/capacity claim later. Corpus: short marketing prompts + 3 longer chat scenarios. I'll paste samples below.

katie.marketing: SAMPLE CORPUS (paste into corpus.json):
1) "Summarize Redwood Inference in one sentence for a developer blog."
2) "Explain the difference between dedicated and hosted deployments in plain terms."
3) "Write a short onboarding checklist for a PLG user enabling Redwood API."
4) "Chat: user asks for code to batch requests and preserve KV cache across calls (context ~2k tokens)."
5) "Chat: multi-turn troubleshooting about high latency when using quantized model (3 turns)."
6) "Generate a 150-token product announcement blurb about release X."

sam.sre: Suggestion for methodology: warm up with 10 sequences of the longest context, then run steady-state until 15k tokens or 5 minutes (whichever comes first) per replica. Add RNG seed 42 for repeatability. Track GPU util, memory, and KV cache hit rate.

jon.runtime: Plan: run 3 reps per variant (fp16, int8), warmup 10, steady 2x 15k tokens. Collect token-level timestamps + heatmap, and output 10 sample responses per run. CSV fields we'll provide: model, variant, run_id, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, tokens_per_sec, gpu_util, cache_hit_pct. Command I'll run:
```
./bench_tool 
  --model open-model-xxl 
  --quant {fp16|int8} 
  --corpus corpus.json 
  --warmup 10 
  --steps 15000 
  --seed 42 
  --out /tmp/launch_spotcheck.csv
```

katie.marketing: Perfect. Can you also include the exact Docker image tag and runtime flags (batching, kv-cache on/off) we used? We need that in the methodology slide.

jon.runtime: Yes — image: redwood/runtime:2026-03-01-rc2. Flags: --adaptive-batching=on --max-batch-size=16 --kv-cache=on. I'll include a short runbook snippet and the minimal artifact bundle. ETA Mon noon. @sam.sre can you validate GPU counters once jobs finish?

runbot: Benchmark job queued: job-7890. Notified eng-runtime.

sam.sre: I'll validate counters and sanity-check logs. If p99 > 1200ms for typical 512-token prompts we'll investigate regressions. Also will save raw stderr logs for the slowest traces. Include raw sample outputs for quality review (we should sanity-check hallucination rate).

katie.marketing: :thumbsup: one more ask — include single-example traces for the 2 slowest p99 cases (token timestamps + config) so we can annotate the slide if there are outliers.

jon.runtime: Copy — will push artifacts to /artifacts/marketing/launch_spotcheck/1762501234/ (csv, outputs.jsonl, runbook.txt, docker_info.txt, heatmap.png) and ping here when done. If anything blocks I'll escalate.
